replacement_cost.source_label: HVS U.S. Hotel Development Cost Survey 2026, Exhibit 6, median total incl. land

supply.missing: No single public source gave the total pipeline (under construction plus planned) as a share of existing rooms for Dulles, Fairfax, Loudoun or the DC metro by Aug 12, 2026.

demand.source_label: Fairfax County FY2025 Carryover Review, Attachment II

debt_context.summary: Pressured seller without formal distress at announcement: AHT's 10-Q (Aug 12, 2026) states substantial doubt about its ability to continue as a going concern and names hotel sales as a source of cash. No loan event was tied to this hotel by then.
No documented trigger dated by Aug 12, 2026. The ~$20.6M lender paydown appears only in the closing 8-K of Aug 27, 2026, after the announcement. Going-concern doubt is not a v1.1 trigger.
